profile.headline: Frontend Software Engineer | Shopify Developer | SaaS, E-Commerce & Technical SEO | Formerly Thrasio & Worldeye | Founder, Devmike.io
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Mike — a software engineer with 6+ years of experience building SaaS products, e-commerce storefronts, and custom web applications.

My strongest focus is frontend engineering with React, TypeScript, and Next.js, alongside experience in full-stack development, API integrations, and Shopify. I’ve worked closely with engineering, product, and marketing teams, connecting technical decisions with how people use a product and what the business needs.

From 2021 to 2023, I worked at Thrasio, where I served as technical lead for a reusable Shopify theme framework deployed across 100+ direct-to-consumer brands. I also contributed to the full-stack development of Thrasio Tools, an internal product catalog platform supporting SKU management, brand data, and operational workflows.

From 2023 to 2026, I led frontend development across Worldeye’s portfolio, including DataHawk, BidX, Viral Launch, Spotlight, and Intellifox. My work included seller analytics applications, AI-powered listing tools, API integrations, and marketing websites supporting product launches and customer acquisition.

I also run Devmike.io, the freelance business I started in 2019. I partner with businesses, founders, and agencies on websites, Shopify development, and custom applications, taking projects from initial requirements through launch. Technical SEO, accessibility, performance, and maintainability are part of how I approach that work.

I’m open to frontend, full-stack, and growth engineering opportunities, as well as freelance projects. Always happy to connect with developers, founders, and teams building useful products.

📩 mlee142295@gmail.com
🌐 devmike.io

positions.title: Founder / Software Developer
positions.description:
I run Devmike.io, partnering with businesses, startups, and agencies to build websites, e-commerce storefronts, and custom web applications. Since 2019, I’ve managed client projects from initial requirements through development, launch, and ongoing improvements.

• Build websites and custom applications with React, TypeScript, Next.js, JavaScript, and APIs. Work across Shopify, WordPress, and other CMS platforms based on each client’s business needs.

• Develop Shopify themes, apps, and reusable sections using Liquid, metafields, metaobjects, and Shopify APIs. Create flexible content systems that help clients manage and update their storefronts.

• Translate business requirements and designs into responsive, accessible interfaces. Focus on clear navigation, product presentation, and maintainable components that support a better customer experience.

• Conduct technical SEO audits and improve site structure, page speed, and Core Web Vitals. Identify and address issues that affect search visibility, usability, and website performance.

• Manage client projects from initial discovery through development, launch, and ongoing support. Advise on platform selection, UX, and technical priorities while managing scope and communication.

My work spans e-commerce, SaaS, hospitality, retail, construction, fitness, and media. Selected clients include Thalora, WC E-Bike Shop, Stay The Hocking Hills, and The Immanuel Quilt Ministry.
positions.insights: Skills: Shopify · Front-End Development · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · JavaScript · React.js · Web Development · LiquidJS · Next.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led frontend development across Worldeye / Seller Suite’s portfolio of e-commerce SaaS platforms, including BidX, DataHawk, Viral Launch, Intellifox, and Spotlight. Worked closely with Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams on seller-facing applications and marketing websites.

• Built applications with React, TypeScript, and Next.js for seller analytics, affiliate partnerships, AI-powered listing tools, and advertising workflows. Collaborated with Engineering and Product on frontend features and user experience.

• Worked on Amazon Selling Partner API (SP-API) integration for keyword research and product discovery tools, supporting workflows that helped Amazon sellers research products and evaluate opportunities.

• Developed and maintained 10+ marketing websites and landing pages across the portfolio. Partnered with Marketing on product launches, customer acquisition, lead generation, and conversion-focused experiences.

• Improved technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and frontend performance across portfolio websites. Worked with Engineering and Marketing to address technical issues and improve the user experience.

• Built reusable frontend components and improved content workflows across brands. Helped teams maintain consistent interfaces, reuse established patterns, and update website content more efficiently.

The portfolio served Amazon and Walmart sellers through advertising automation (BidX), analytics (DataHawk), seller research and optimization tools (Viral Launch), listing and advertising tools (Intellifox), and affiliate partnerships (Spotlight).
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Software Development · JavaScript · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · TypeScript · Front-End Development · React.js · Vue.js · C# · Software Design · Web Engineering · Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer - Shopify & DTC
positions.description:
Worked across Thrasio’s DTC and Product Catalog teams, building Shopify storefronts, brand applications, and internal software. My work focused on reusable storefront systems, customer experience, and tools supporting brand operations.

• Served as technical lead for a reusable Shopify theme framework deployed across 100+ DTC brands. Focused on storefront performance, technical SEO, and a consistent foundation for brand-specific experiences.

• Built reusable Shopify sections, storefront components, and custom UX features with the Site Merchandising team. Supported product presentation and shopping experiences across the brand portfolio.

• Developed DTC brand applications with the Consumer Engineering team, adding functionality to support customer needs and expand the brands’ digital offerings.

• Contributed to full-stack development of Thrasio Tools with the Product Catalog team. Built features supporting brand catalog visualization, SKU management, and internal operational workflows.

• Partnered with the Google SEO team on technical SEO improvements and organic search initiatives. Implemented changes across brand websites to support search visibility and storefront performance.

projects.title: Coffee Brew Catalog
projects.description:
Building a coffee product discovery platform that helps enthusiasts explore products from across Shopify merchants. Developed with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, with searchable product listings, category filtering, and a responsive browsing experience.

Integrated Shopify’s Global Catalog through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), using server-side JSON-RPC requests to retrieve product data. Implemented cursor-based pagination and fallback handling, and refined filtering behavior to improve the relevance of displayed results.

Own the project from concept and interface design through development and iteration, combining my experience in frontend engineering, e-commerce, and product discovery.
